env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^name$'
logos eject -o out
! grep -E 'Logos_Get|Logos_Set' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ../..
cd bad
! logos build ./...
stderr 'missing method Logos_GetName'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constmethod

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Readable interface {
	const Name() string
}

type Thing struct{}

func (Thing) Name() string {
	return "name"
}

func use(r Readable) string {
	return r.Name()
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(use(Thing{}))
}
-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/bad

go 1.27

-- bad/main.lgo --
package main

type Prop interface {
	const Name string
}

type RO interface {
	const Name() string
}

func asProp(r RO) Prop { return r }

func main() {}
